title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: This document outlines the AI Office’s decision on key policy matters affecting artificial intelligence deployment and governance. It establishes guidelines for compliance, risk mitigation, and accountability within the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy announces a new vacancy for technology specialists in the AI office, highlighting the need for experts to advance the organization’s AI initiatives. It outlines the responsibilities and qualifications required for candidates to support and develop the AI strategy.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This policy document announces a vacancy for the position of Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. It outlines the responsibilities, required qualifications, and application process for candidates interested in leading AI research and strategy.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy announces a vacancy for legal officers within the AI office, detailing the duties of overseeing AI-related legal compliance, risk management, and regulatory adherence. It outlines the necessary qualifications, responsibilities, and application process for candidates seeking the position.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This policy outlines the procedures for filling AI office vacancies and defines the responsibilities of policy officers. It ensures that the organization maintains a robust governance framework for AI initiatives.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts convened to evaluate and advise on the European Union’s proposed AI legislation. They assess the technical, ethical, and societal implications of AI systems, recommending regulatory measures to ensure safety, transparency, and accountability.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This document is a request to create a standard for certain AI-related practices or guidelines. It explains why standardization is needed and proposes ways to develop and adopt those standards.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces an upcoming consultation on developing a community of practice (CoP). Stakeholders are invited to share feedback on how the CoP should be structured, governed, and operated.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document announces a call for people to express interest in joining or contributing to a Community of Practice (CoP). It invites individuals or organizations to submit their intentions and outlines the next steps for participation.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document explains the step-by-step approach used in a community of practice to continuously improve drafts. It shows how feedback is collected, revised, and re-evaluated in an ongoing cycle to produce better policies.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This policy document shows a graphic timeline of how the AI policy was drafted, highlighting the main stages and key milestones. It provides a clear, step‑by‑step overview of the dates, phases, and decision points that shaped the final policy.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document presents the first draft of a Code of Practice for AI. It sets out basic rules and guidelines to help ensure AI systems are designed, used, and governed responsibly.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: The “Code of Practice: 2nd Draft” outlines the updated set of standards and responsibilities for developing and deploying artificial intelligence systems. It emphasizes transparency, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement to guide organizations in aligning AI use with ethical and regulatory expectations.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: A Code of Practice: 3rd Draft outlines guidelines and standards for the responsible design, development, and deployment of AI systems, focusing on safety, fairness, and transparency. It incorporates updates to address evolving ethical concerns and regulatory requirements, providing a framework for oversight and accountability.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a collaborative framework for responsible AI development and deployment, stressing safety, transparency, and shared accountability. It proposes shared principles and concrete steps for governments, industry, and civil society to mitigate risks and ensure AI benefits society.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final outlines a comprehensive agreement among stakeholders to ensure responsible AI development and deployment. It includes principles for transparency, safety, fairness, and collaboration across the industry and governments.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy outlines specific AI activities that are prohibited to prevent misuse and harm. It serves as a guide to ensure responsible use of AI by defining what practices are disallowed.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy explains how to define an AI system for regulatory and accountability purposes, giving clear criteria for what counts as AI. It focuses on characteristics such as automated decision‑making, learning ability, and integration into products or services.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines how the government will communicate its efforts to stimulate start‑ups and foster innovation across the economy. It highlights key initiatives, funding opportunities, and collaboration platforms designed to help early‑stage companies grow and bring new technologies to market.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a program that gives early‑stage companies access to high‑performance computing resources, training, and funding to help them develop AI and other computational technologies. It also provides networking and collaboration opportunities so start‑ups can grow and compete in the European AI ecosystem.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This slideshow presents an overview of risk management practices. It covers key principles, tools, and strategies for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks in various contexts.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar explains the basics of risk management, covering how to identify, assess, and prioritize potential risks that could impact an organization. It also offers practical strategies for mitigating those risks and maintaining compliance with industry standards.
